verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples. The evidence covers docs pages, llms.txt, markdown docs and an MCP server for searching docs, which are adjacent features rather than an interactive reference. All probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, so there is no evidence of a machine-readable spec behind one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
